consequence.statement: Existing ImageRepository objects stay stored as v1beta2 until they are rewritten. If they are not migrated and status.storedVersions is not updated, they will still be stored as v1beta2 when a later release removes v1beta2.
consequence.remediation: Run a storage version migration that rewrites every ImageRepository object, then remove v1beta2 from status.storedVersions on the imagerepositories.image.toolkit.fluxcd.io CRD.

assertion.statement: The storage version of the imagerepositories.image.toolkit.fluxcd.io CRD moves from v1beta2 to v1. Existing ImageRepository objects stay stored as v1beta2 until they are rewritten, so a storage version migration and a status.storedVersions update are needed before a later release removes v1beta2.
